description: This file declares classes and interfaces for mDNS (multicast DNS) client implementation, including socket factory, connection handling, cache management, and listener/transaction classes within the net namespace.

classes.name: MDnsSocketFactoryImpl
classes.description: Implements socket creation for mDNS using a provided NetLog.

classes.name: MDnsConnection
classes.description: Manages network connection for multicast DNS, handles socket communication, and delegates packet handling.

classes.name: MDnsClientImpl
classes.description: Main implementation of the MDnsClient interface, manages cache, listeners, and network connection.

classes.name: MDnsListenerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of MDnsListener, manages listening for specific DNS records and refresh logic.

classes.name: MDnsTransactionImpl
classes.description: Handles DNS query transactions, manages cache responses, and transaction lifecycle.

methods.name: CreateSockets
methods.description: Creates and initializes UDP sockets for mDNS communication.

methods.name: HandlePacket
methods.description: Processes incoming DNS responses and updates cache/listeners accordingly.

methods.name: SendQuery
methods.description: Sends a DNS query over the network.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins listening for DNS records or transactions.

methods.name: SetActiveRefresh
methods.description: Enables or disables active refresh for DNS records.

methods.name: HandleRecordUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to DNS records and notifies delegate.

methods.name: TriggerCallback
methods.description: Invokes the transaction result callback with the outcome.
